bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the prediction distributions and confidence scores of off-the-shelf language identification algorithms on Creole text to reveal a false prediction bias towards high-resource European languages, and evaluating whether Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO) improves language modeling performance for under-resourced Creole languages across intrinsic (MLM precision, pseudo-log-likelihood) and extrinsic (NER, POS tagging) tasks.
